summary_md: Made the Market Intel — By Era table use table-fixed with reserved column widths for Sets/Avg/Value and a truncating Era column (with title tooltip), so the Value column no longer gets pushed off the panel edge at 1024px. — researched from the venture's brain (semantic), planned as a PRP with 4 validation gate(s) (written), then passed on round 1 of 2 against them plus tests, /review review pass (0 critical) and /qa: Booted backend (:3001) and frontend (:5173) headless, signed up a fresh QA user, loaded /overview at 1024x900 with Playwright. Verified via bounding-box measurement, pixel-level zoom, and a viewport-edge marker overlay that all Market Intel — By Era VALUE column figures ($8105, $4740, $412, $190, $9291) and the VALUE header render fully within the 1024px viewport with no visual clipping, matching the ticket's acceptance criteria. No console errors observed..
